title: Do not convert unspecified stock completeness to PARTIAL
description: The author decision common_publication_conditions[5] instructs PARTIAL for shared incomplete stocks, but the native enum requires explicit source evidence of omitted constituents. Named-stock evidence that does not settle completeness supports UNKNOWN. This also appears in frozen control941 (0.2MTris) and955 (2MHEPES). The root already clarified UNKNOWN for forthcoming simple-stock candidates; this report preserves the original recommendation and control bytes rather than claim they are repaired. This is a metadata representation correction, not a reason to discard the supported nominal scopes. Other recipe-based controls280/938 need source-specific completeness adjudication, not mechanical retyping.
normalization_reason: The nominal identities are supported and nothing is installed; metadata must be corrected before eventual publication. No gate is waived.
ownership_note: Coordinator composition guidance and the named frozen worker proposal controls; no maintained record changes in this review.
